create_BlockDataset: create a BlockDataset that chunks token sequences into blocks with configurable break mode and span masking parameters
create_NoNSPSpanBertDataset: create a NoNSPSpanBertDataset wrapping BlockDataset with configurable masking schemes for span BERT pretraining
collate_NoNSPSpanBertDataset_samples: collate a batch of NoNSPSpanBertDataset samples into padded tensors with source tokens, segment labels, and pair targets
mask_NoNSPSpanBertDataset_block: mask a token block using random, pair span, or ner span masking schemes for masked language model training
get_NoNSPSpanBertDataset_ordered_indices: get ordered indices from NoNSPSpanBertDataset for deterministic or shuffled batch construction
